## The repair, and the precedent to copy

PR objectui#9595 landed the settled form on the sibling gate: **keep the instruction, lose the keyword, and spell the anchor `objectui#` rather than a bare `#`**. Copy that shape here.

⚠️ **Verification must RENDER the message, ⛔ not read its template.** objectui#9595 pays this debt with a harness that copies the real gate into a throwaway workspace, substitutes a seeded ledger, spawns it against a fixture and reads what it prints — with lit controls in both directions. A template-reading assertion cannot tell a repaired emitter from a broken one once the ledger is empty. Reuse that harness.

⚠️ **The sweep that finds these must collapse template-literal concatenation and backslash-n escapes before matching** — this file splits the sentence across concatenated chunks, so a single-line `git grep` sees only part of it and **under-counts**. That is why this site outlived three repairs of the same class.

## Ask
